stage_a_standalone_statement_draft: For a family $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to S\}$, let $\mathrm{DD}(\mathcal U)$ be the category of families of $U_i$-schemes $V_i$ together with isomorphisms $\varphi_{ij}:V_i\times_SU_j\xrightarrow{\sim}U_i\times_SV_j$ over $U_i\times_SU_j$ satisfying the cocycle condition on triple overlaps. A morphism of families $(\alpha,g_i):\mathcal U\to\mathcal V=\{V_j\to S\}$ comprises a function $\alpha:I\to J$ and maps $g_i:U_i\to V_{\alpha(i)}$ over $S$; it induces a pullback functor $\mathrm{DD}(\mathcal V)\to\mathrm{DD}(\mathcal U)$. Let $X=\coprod_{i\in I}X_i$ for a family $\{X_i\to S\}$. Then the category of descent data for schemes relative to the family is canonically equivalent to $\mathrm{DD}(X/S)$, by taking $V=\coprod_iV_i$ and identifying the descent isomorphism over $X\times_SX=\coprod_{i,j}(X_i\times_SX_j)$ with the disjoint union of the maps $\varphi_{ij}$.
stage_b_review_note: Preserves equivalence of scheme descent data for a family {Xi→S} and for its disjoint-union morphism X=⊔Xi→S. The operation on descended objects V=⊔Vi and descent isomorphisms φ=⊔φij is retained.

conclusions: Family descent data and descent data along the coproduct map are equivalent categories.
